summary: The experts say to buy ICICI Bank shares in India and keep the one hundred dollars in cash in America for now. They are debating whether state-owned banks like Punjab National Bank and Canara Bank are too risky because their prices have dropped sharply in the past. They also note that with ten thousand rupees you cannot afford a single share of most car or battery companies except Ola Electric, which has jumped in price recently but is very speculative.
